label: Full-shift depth three, linear observations
title: Under the self-dual linear observation 150 the rings decide full-shift depth three exactly; under 90 four rules separate
kind: Exact full-shift certificate of refinement depth at most three under the two linear observations 90 and 150
summary: Full-shift depth at most three is decided for every rule under 90, 150 and 90's conjugate 165 by the same sparse pair-graph method as the sixteenth unit. Twelve rules are excluded by pen as controls; of the rest, 14 of 18 under 90 and all 24 under 150 have full-shift depth exactly three, and only four rules are deeper. The rings-3-to-14 depth-three gap is nonempty under 90 but empty under 150: the first time in the program a gap closes rather than widens.
takeaway: Whether periodic configurations decide a given depth level is a property of the pair (observation, level), not a uniform fact about depth: under one linear observation the ring-3-to-14 gap widens at depth three, under the other it closes.
